name: laioutr-design-manager
description: Laioutr Design Manager — two senior design agents for Laioutr projects: ui-designer (builds components and the design system directly in Figma, synced with the Laioutr UI kit and Storybook, variables-only library with theme × color scheme × light/dark, end-to-end to buildable Vue sections/blocks) and ux-designer (composes existing sections/blocks into pages and marketing-driven landing pages and fills them with data in Laioutr Studio).
